name: UCCS XC Open
where: Colorado Springs, CO · host UC-Colorado Springs · Monument Valley Park
headline: UCCS XC Open
summary: Final: Unattached Sophia Christensen won the women's 6K in 21:17.6, ahead of Regis's Allie Braney (21:23.1) and Fort Lewis freshman Eliana Angelino (21:34.4). CSU-Pueblo went 1-2 in the men's 8K, with Jon Sweepe winning in 24:52.3 and Caden Schweer second in 25:04.0.
